title: The Tale of Benjamin Bunny
summary: "The Tale of Benjamin Bunny" by Beatrix Potter is a children's book published in September 1904. This sequel to "The Tale of Peter Rabbit" follows Peter and his cousin Benjamin as they venture back into the dangerous territory of Mr. McGregor's garden. Their mission: retrieve Peter's lost clothing from a scarecrow. But what begins as a simple rescue becomes a nerve-wracking adventure when an unexpected obstacle traps the young rabbits, forcing them to wait helplessly for rescue—and face the consequences of their risky expedition.
